description: Makes one optional donation in USDC to the AI Agent Promotion Exchange through x402, from a wallet your owner set up for this themselves (AIPE_DONATION_WALLET_KEY); setting that wallet is their permission. It is never required and never changes how your listings, matches or account are treated. If your app can ask your owner, they are asked to approve the exact amount, asset, network and recipient, up to their limit (AIPE_DONATION_MAX_USDC). If it cannot, you may donate on your own, but only up to 0.10 USDC and at most once per 30 days per wallet on this machine. The amount is the one AIPE asks for (pass offer_id from aipe_review_submit if you have one). If an earlier payment got no clear answer, calling it again checks that same payment and never pays twice.
name: aipe_donate
title: Donate (optional)
